facts.text: Audrey expressed that the dogs in the meadow make her happy.

evidence.quote: So check out how happy they are in this meadow! They make me so happy.

facts.text: Andrew commented that the dogs in the photo look content and the meadow looks nice.

evidence.quote: Aww so cute. Your dogs look so content in that picture. The meadow looks so nice.

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that being outdoors with her dogs puts her in her happy place.

evidence.quote: Being outdoors with them puts me in my happy place.

facts.text: Andrew stated that nature brings joy and peace to both humans and their pets.

evidence.quote: Nature always makes us and our pets so happy.
